points.description: Tool point: the origin of gripper_frame_link in the SO-101 URDF (so101_new_calib.urdf), fixed to the gripper 98 mm along the wrist_roll axis from that joint's frame origin (and 8 mm off the axis), toward the jaw tips.
Elbow joint centre: the origin of the elbow_flex joint frame in the SO-101 URDF (link lower_arm_link), on the elbow_flex axis at the end of the upper arm.
Wrist joint centre: the origin of the wrist_flex joint frame in the SO-101 URDF (link wrist_link), on the wrist_flex axis at the end of the forearm.

notes: Converted from an ev03-harness arm envelope. As in the harness, keep_in bounds the tool point only, link_keep_in bounds the link points (elbow, wrist), and every keep_out applies to every point. The harness applied max_joint_speed_dps to the five arm joints, not the gripper. The stop and heartbeat blocks were supplied at conversion; the harness format declares neither. EV-03 envelope for Craig's SO-ARM101 'bob' (12 V STS3215, servo calibration as stored on the arm, read 2026-10-08). Base frame: the URDF base_link of so101_new_calib.urdf, x forward (left along the sill), y left, z up, metres. (The harness comment said the origin is under shoulder_pan; base_link's origin is 38.8 mm behind the shoulder_pan axis and 2.4 mm above the table, which is what every coordinate here was computed in.) The box is virtual, in free space around the arm's straight-up pose, well above the sill. The keep-out is also virtual: it exercises the keep-out logic. keep_out_0: virtual fixture, left front lower corner. link_keep_in: Box for the elbow and wrist joint centres: the space above the sill, 5 cm clear of the base plate. Loose on purpose: the joint_map is fitted to about +/-10 deg, so link positions are known to a few cm. The stop and heartbeat values are illustrative placeholders, not measured: EV-02 (stop time and distance) has not been run on this arm.
